speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Skin Biopsy Histopathology reveals acantholysis and intraepidermal blister formation. Direct Immunofluorescence shows intercellular IgG and C3 deposition within the epidermis. Blood tests confirm the presence of desmoglein antibodies.

speaker: Doctor
text: The biopsy results showing acantholysis, intercellular IgG and C3 deposition, and positive desmoglein antibodies confirm a diagnosis of Pemphigus Vulgaris. DIAGNOSIS READY: Pemphigus Vulgaris
